name: mnemonic_afterglow_manipulation
label: Mnemonic Afterglow Manipulation
godotFeature: GPUParticles3D with custom ShaderMaterial, Physics Interactions
poeticVision: A desperate, fleeting grasp at what slips away. The player will feel the gut-wrenching urgency of turning a fragment's dying breath into a momentary shield against oblivion or a fragile weapon against the Silence. It's the bitter joy of salvaging a tiny, transient edge from irreversible loss, a continuous act of making tragedy useful, cementing the feeling that Lyra is literally fighting with the remnants of her dissolving self.

parameters.name: afterglow_particle_scene
parameters.description: The PackedScene containing the pre-configured GPUParticles3D node that will be instantiated.

parameters.name: afterglow_lifetime
parameters.description: The base duration in seconds for which a spawned afterglow instance persists before fading out and being freed.

parameters.name: shield_duration
parameters.description: The duration in seconds for which the afterglow acts as a temporary shield.

parameters.name: projectile_speed
parameters.description: The speed in units per second at which an afterglow projectile travels.

parameters.name: platform_duration
parameters.description: The duration in seconds for which the afterglow solidifies into a temporary platform.

parameters.name: afterglow_base_color
parameters.description: The starting color for the particles of the afterglow effect.

parameters.name: afterglow_fade_color
parameters.description: The ending color for the particles as the afterglow effect fades over its lifetime.

dependencies: res://scenes/afterglow_particles.tscn (example path to a GPUParticles3D scene)
res://shaders/mnemonic_afterglow.gdshader (example path to the custom shader)
verdict: From the fading echoes of self, a desperate light ignites, forging fleeting tools against the encroaching night.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally deepen the player's connection to Lyra's struggle. Every recovered memory becomes a desperate, tactical choice, forcing players to weigh the immediate need for survival against the irreversible loss of identity. The transient nature of these abilities will create constant tension and a unique rhythm of resource management, where the 'resource' is Lyra's very self, making every action a poignant act of defiance against oblivion. It perfectly embodies the game's core themes of self-loss and urgent survival, ensuring that every interaction with a memory fragment is a moment of high stakes and emotional resonance.
